void precompute_comb() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= total_len; ++i) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
            comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
    }

ll compute_diffs(int config, int a_before, int b_before) {
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < cols + 1; ++i) {
        if (config & (1 << i)) {
            ++b_before;
            ll aux1 = comb[b_before - 1][rows - 1];
            ll aux2 = comb[total_len - b_before][rows] - comb[a_before][rows];
            ans -= aux1 * aux2;
        } else {
            ++a_before;
            ll aux1 = comb[a_before - 1][rows - 1];
            ll aux2 = comb[total_len - a_before][rows] - comb[b_before][rows];
            ans += aux1 * aux2;
        }
    }
    return ans;

        if (str[2 * rows + cols + i] == 'B' && ((config >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;

    return true;

    int limit = 1 << (cols + 1);

        sort(partZero[i].begin(), partZero[i].end());

int r, c, n, i;
char s[MAXN];
ll comb[MAXN][MAXN];

int cnt_a[MAXN], cnt_b[MAXN];
vector<ll> partial[MAXN], partial_zero[MAXN];

void compute_comb() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
            comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
    }
}

ll get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
        if (conf & (1 << i)) {
            ++b_bef;
            ll aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
            ll aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
            ans -= aux1 * aux2;
        } else {
            ++a_bef;
            ll aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
            ll aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
            ans += aux1 * aux2;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool check(int conf) {
    for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
        if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1)) return false;
        if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && !((conf >> i) & 1)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void compute_second_part() {
    int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
    for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; ++conf) {
        int b_here = __builtin_popcount(conf);
        int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
        ll val = get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here);
        if (check(conf))
            partial[a_here].push_back(val);
        else
            partial_zero[a_here].push_back(val);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
        sort(partial[i].begin(), partial[i].end());
        sort(partial_zero[i].begin(), partial_zero[i].end());
    }
}

ll get_coef(int conf) {
    int i, j;
    for (i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i)
        if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
            break;
    for (j = i; j < c + 1; ++j) {
        if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && ((conf >> j) & 1)) return 0;
        if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && !((conf >> j) & 1)) return 0;
    }
    int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
    int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
    if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
    if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
    return comb[set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
}

void upd(pair<ll, ll>& ans, pair<ll, ll> act) {
    if (act.first < 0) act.first = -act.first;
    if (ans.first < act.first) return;
    if (ans.first > act.first) {
        ans = act;
        return;
    }
    ans.second += act.second;
}

ll how_many(vector<ll>& data, ll val) {
    auto it1 = lower_bound(data.begin(), data.end(), val);
    auto it2 = upper_bound(data.begin(), data.end(), val);
    return it2 - it1;
}

ll compute_first_part() {
    int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
    pair<ll, ll> ans = make_pair(1LL << 60, 0);
    for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; ++conf) {
        int b_here = __builtin_popcount(conf);
        int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
        ll act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
        ll coef = get_coef(conf);
        auto it = lower_bound(partial[c + 1 - a_here].begin(), partial[c + 1 - a_here].end(), -act);
        if (it != partial[c + 1 - a_here].end()) {
            if (ans.first >= abs(*it + act)) {
                ll cnt = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], *it);
                upd(ans, make_pair(*it + act, coef * cnt));
            }
        }
        if (it != partial[c + 1 - a_here].begin()) {
            --it;
            if (ans.first >= abs(*it + act)) {
                ll cnt = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], *it);
                upd(ans, make_pair(*it + act, coef * cnt));
            }
        }
        coef = 0;
        it = lower_bound(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].begin(), partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].end(), -act);
        if (it != partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].end()) {
            if (ans.first >= abs(*it + act)) {
                ll cnt = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], *it);
                upd(ans, make_pair(*it + act, coef * cnt));
            }
        }
        if (it != partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].begin()) {
            --it;
            if (ans.first >= abs(*it + act)) {
                ll cnt = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], *it);
                upd(ans, make_pair(*it + act, coef * cnt));
            }
        }
    }
    return ans.second;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d\n%s", &r, &c, s + 1);
    n = 2 * (r + c);
    compute_comb();
    for (i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i-1] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i-1] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    compute_second_part();
    ll sol = compute_first_part();
    printf("%lld", sol);
    return 0;
}
